data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my overall recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify — in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

If your business is based in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Für Hello Kitty Fans - Mibrix](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tOiZ9v22mWkKDkODjZ-v8UmHuYEacS351-fhJlicedtzRtyvIPyT0LbHRVsov1FwCqimbt2M5XbGmMjfcFRqoBnSC867jR1vj2Q9kN8GWqWxrNowdJCqgKFlsNcxOvUQZiEoQ3wUV3e9Iv-ULg-8O_uiwrVTYdmAuanbvrKZ5q48tOAeoqXUh_tpwPm1cZkj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy to integrate with most online stores.
- Accepts credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Good recurring payments and international payment support.
- Australian domestic card pricing: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.
  
  Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and online-first businesses.
  
  [Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple setup and reporting.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Basic plan Australian online domestic card pricing listed at approximately 1.75% + A\$0.30.
  
  [Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognised and trusted by many customers.
- Convenient checkout option.
- Useful as an additional payment method alongside Stripe.
- Higher fees than some alternatives.
  
  [PayPal Australia Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Integrates payments and inventory.
- Straightforward business tools.
  
  [Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Airwallex**

- Particularly useful for international customers.
- Multi-currency payment and settlement options.
- Integrations with ecommerce and accounting platforms.
  
  [Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Indicative Australian pricing; actual fees vary by card type, plan, currency and transaction circumstances. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Just starting an online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WordPress / WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Stripe or Airwallex |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Want customers to have PayPal | Add PayPal alongside your main processor |


One important tip: don't necessarily choose the processor with the lowest transaction fee. Also consider refunds, chargeback fees, fraud protection, payout times and currency conversion.
